description: Skills whose module reaches further than the effect_scope they declare. Every entry here spawns a process, and the analyser does not distinguish spawning a repo-literal program (`say`, `manim`, `pytest`) from spawning one a caller named — that distinction is made by tests/test_general_execution_surfaces_are_governed.py, which asks the Will for the second kind. Escalating all of them to privileged_mutation would make voice output need privileged authority, which is a behaviour regression dressed as a fix. No entry here is classified `observe`: a skill that promises no effect and has one is corrected, never grandfathered. This list may only SHRINK: tools/check_skill_effect_scope.py fails on any mismatch not listed here and refuses to add one.
